result.title: TrajCal: Trajectory-Calibrated Time Schedules for Few-Step Flow Sampling
result.summary: Flow matching enables high-quality image and video generation, but its iterative sampling process requires repeated evaluations of large neural networks. Existing few-step methods can distort the output and reduce its agreement with a many-step reference. We propose TrajCal, a training-free calibration framework for few-step sampling. Based on scatter search, a well-established metaheuristic for difficult optimization problems, TrajCal starts with diverse seed schedules, deforms and combines these candidates, and selects one fixed schedule by final output fidelity for reuse on new inputs. For both image and video generation, TrajCal achieves higher reference fidelity than all compared baselines at low evaluation budgets while maintaining competitive visual quality. The search is effective even with randomly generated seeds, while trajectory-based seeds further improve fidelity. For cross-style generalization, photography-calibrated schedules also improve fidelity on unseen image styles.

AI.brief_summary: TrajCal 提出免训练的 few-step flow sampling 校准框架：以 scatter search 从多样种子调度出发变形、组合候选，再按最终输出与多步参考的保真度选出一个固定时间调度复用于新输入，在图像与视频生成上以较低评估预算取得更高参考保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「与多步参考的保真度」搜索步预算与时间调度的做法，可能为 latent 推理中离散步数分配和以全计算参考评价轨迹提供类比线索；但调度固定、面向图像生成，是否可迁移到 THINK/STOP 或动态计算仍需核查。
